reviews.author: Lukeisha Terry
reviews.text: I just want to say thank you to Streater Towing! My Tesla hydroplaned in the rain, and I ended up stuck in a ditch with my daughter. I called several towing companies in the area, but no one could get to us right away. When I called Streater Towing, they told me they would be there within 15 minutes, and they kept their word. The driver arrived quickly and had us safely out of the ditch in about 10 minutes. He was professional, respectful, careful with my vehicle, and truly a blessing during a stressful situation. Excellent customer service, fast response time, and genuine care for their customers. I highly recommend Streater Towing to anyone in need of roadside assistance or towing services. Thank you again for turning a difficult situation into a positive experience!

reviews.author: Carla Hwang
reviews.text: Called to have towing help in a stressful situation and was completely BLESSED....super fast service and exceptional service! THANK YOU SO MUCH!

reviews.author: Kat Baggs
reviews.text: HANDS DOWN..THE BEST TOWING COMPANY AROUND..super fast..i had a insurance claim and it took less then 15 min for them to arrive..ALL THIS DURING THE ICE STORM..then come to to find out I didn't lock myself out in the first place and the gentleman was very nice about it and just wanted to make sure we were ok..WOW USE THIS COMPANY..YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!!!

reviews.author: barry lipscomb
reviews.text: Great job getting the car to the school, my father had great things to say about the driver . He also helped push the car into the bay and didn’t have to. Would definitely recommend them for your next tow

reviews.author: Kristin Maney
reviews.text: 0/10 would not recommend this company if you want a reliable and trustworthy company. One of their drivers hit my car in his tow truck, totaled it, and now they’re telling me they don’t have an active insurance policy to cover my loses. Find a different company for your towing needs.

reviews.author: Ben Poston
reviews.text: Got there super fast. He was very polite and friendly. Not only does he take cash but he also does cash app for ease of payment. 10/10

reviews.author: Morgan Hahn
reviews.text: My back tire went flat on my bike. They were the only company that would come out and tow it home for me. They were amazing and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kimberly Miller
reviews.text: Marcus was very professional and helpful. He went over and beyond to assist during my towing service.

reviews.author: Deanna Trull
reviews.text: Streater towing gave excellent service and was extremely nice. He came to SC to tow my car back to NC after we was in an accident. Got my daughter and myself back safely. Highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Crystal Sims
reviews.text: Great professional service. Late night car issues, answered call, arrived when indicated, took care of the car needs. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kaylee Tursack
reviews.text: Wonderful experience!! Super fast and a good price. Called me back asap! Brought it and picked it up exactly as told. Will work with them again as needed!!

reviews.author: jamie jordan
reviews.text: I have been buying and selling cars for over 25 years! This was the most efficient and quickest towing service I’ve ever used! I HIGHLY recommend!

reviews.author: Xavier Johnson
reviews.text: Thank you for going the extra mile for me, and my family. Towing our classic cars with extreme amounts of care. With videos and photos at pickup and delivery 10 out 10 would definitely use streater towing again

reviews.author: Steven Keodara (Th3onlysteve0)
reviews.text: The guys very helpful and understanding as well as completing the job in a timely manner. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: Tajhshana Fudge
reviews.text: Very unprofessional, they never called me back to let me know that my vehicle was dropped off to it’s destination safely.

reviews.author: Glamma Girl
reviews.text: I prayed and God sent me to this business...Very professional, fast, and he worked around my needs this morning with no hesitation...Will definitely use again and recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Mary Nigrelli
reviews.text: They are affordable, great customer service and very quick. I’ll be recommending them to anyone I know who needs a vehicle towed.
